Attribute.Name: Variant?
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="{
    i:=path(),
    parent:=listitem(
        i,
         listlen(i)-1
    ),
    ParentOT:=iterate(parent, 'StepObjectTypeID()'),
    isAssignedMP:=if(
        exact(ParentOT, "PMDM.PRD.InternalMasterProduct"),
        'true',
        'false'
    ),
    pdxMasterProductID:=value('PMDM.AT.PDS.MasterProductID'),
    result:=if(
        isAssignedMP='true',
         concatenate(
            iterate(
                stepurl2objid(
                    stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_Yes")
                ),"value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"
            ),"\n",
            iterate(
                stepurl2objid(
                    stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_AssignedTo")
                ),"value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"
            ),": ",
            iterate(parent, '{masterProdName:=stepname()}if(len(masterProdName)>0, masterProdName, concatenate("(", stepid(), ")"))')
        ),
        concatenate(
            iterate(
                stepurl2objid(
                    stepurl('entity', 'SysMsg_No')
                ),
                'value("PMDM.AT.SystemMessage")'
            ),
            iterate(
                stepurl2objid(
                    stepurl()
                ),
                '{providedID:=if(len(pdxMasterProductID)>0, pdxMasterProductID, iterate(iterate(referencesto("Product", "PMDM.PRT.GoldenToSourceRecord"), "referenceowner()"), \'value("PMDM.AT.PDS.MasterProductID")\'))}if(len(providedID)>0, concatenate("\n",iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_ProvidedID")), "value(\'PMDM.AT.SystemMessage\')"), ": ", providedID), "")'
            )
        )
    )
}
concatenate(result)"/>
